en.t: The gatekeeper had already fallen asleep.

units.source_text: 便门内倒贴了一张内部规则，内容是："晚上十点以后，最后回寺者锁门。"

en.t: On the inside of the side door, a copy of the internal rules had been pasted upside down; it read: "After ten o'clock at night, the last person to return to the temple must lock the gate."

units.source_text: 还有两块尚未把牌面目过去的名牌。

en.t: There were still two nameplates whose faces had not yet been turned over.

units.source_text: 一块是老师的，另一块是上年纪的管理员的。

en.t: One belonged to the teacher, and the other to the elderly caretaker.
